reference_format.note: YY/TYPE/NNNN - two-digit year, an application-type code, then the serial: 26/PAHE/1302, 26/REG5/1306, 26/DOC/1258.

bot_protection.behaviour: Every dynamic request to the Tascomi dispatcher (index.html?fa=*), GET or POST, is answered with HTTP 202 and an 'x-amzn-waf-action: challenge' response header instead of the page or data asked for. On XHR-style requests the 202 arrives with an EMPTY body, so a client that only looks at the body sees an empty-but-successful response rather than a refusal - the status code and the header are the only tell. No token is obtainable without a real browser, so there is no HTTP route to the register or its documents.

browser_route.note: Hand the user this link and stop. <ID> is Tascomi's internal numeric application id, not the planning reference - PlanIt's applics `url` carries it in exactly this form (?fa=getApplication&id=<id>), and PlanIt supplies no docs_url and no n_documents for Tascomi, so the document list can only be seen in the browser. With no id to hand, give the search UI instead: https://rspandlp.merton.gov.uk/planning/index.html?fa=search.

quirks.summary: XHR-style requests get the challenge as an empty-bodied HTTP 202, which reads as a successful empty result rather than a block.
quirks.detail: A caller that checks only for a 4xx/5xx or for a 'Blocked' string will conclude the application has no documents. Branch on the 202 status together with the x-amzn-waf-action header.
quirks.workaround: Treat 202 + x-amzn-waf-action as terminal: stop and hand over the browser_route link.

quirks.summary: Only rspandlp.merton.gov.uk is live: merton.tascomi.com resolves but returns 523, and planning.merton.gov.uk does not resolve at all.
quirks.detail: Neither alternative host is a way round the challenge; they are dead ends recorded so they are not retried.

quirks.summary: Merton migrated off Northgate Planning Explorer to Tascomi 'Regulatory Services Hub' - any cached row or label still saying Planning Explorer is stale.
quirks.detail: Applying the Planning Explorer recipe here retrieves nothing; re-resolve the vendor before trusting an older record.

quirks.summary: PlanIt uids for this authority are prefixed 'Merton/'.
quirks.detail: Useful when matching a PlanIt record to a Merton reference.

quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

source_notes: MIGRATED off Northgate PE to Tascomi 'Regulatory Services Hub' (Idox group) — see the tascomi vendor entry for detection + the AWS WAF challenge details. Internal numeric id from PlanIt applics url (?fa=getApplication&id=<id>). PlanIt supplies NO docs_url/n_documents for Tascomi. Every dynamic index.html?fa=* request -> HTTP 202 x-amzn-waf-action: challenge (XHR gets an EMPTY 202 body — silent trap). No token obtainable without a real browser. User deep links: detail …/planning/index.html?fa=getApplication&id=<id>; search …/planning/index.html?fa=search. merton.tascomi.com resolves but 523s; planning.merton.gov.uk does not resolve. Ref formats YY/TYPE/NNNN (26/PAHE/1302, 26/REG5/1306, 26/DOC/1258); PlanIt uids prefixed 'Merton/'.
